checkin_types_scope_team_constraint.name: checkin_types_scope_team_constraint
checkin_types_scope_team_constraint.value:
(
				("checkin_types"."scope" = 'team' AND "checkin_types"."team_id" IS NOT NULL)
				OR
				("checkin_types"."scope" = 'organization' AND "checkin_types"."team_id" IS NULL)
			)

wa_manual_send_idempotency_completion_ch.name: wa_manual_send_idempotency_completion_check
wa_manual_send_idempotency_completion_ch.value: (status = 'processing' AND message_id IS NULL AND outbox_id IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'completed' AND message_id IS NOT NULL AND outbox_id IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

assignment_submissions_task_or_deliverab.name: assignment_submissions_task_or_deliverable
assignment_submissions_task_or_deliverab.value: (task_id IS NOT NULL AND deliverable_id IS NULL) OR (task_id IS NULL AND deliverable_id IS NOT NULL)

booking_events_timeline_shape.name: booking_events_timeline_shape
booking_events_timeline_shape.value: (is_tentative = false AND event_date IS NOT NULL AND date_window IS NULL) OR (is_tentative = true AND event_date IS NULL AND nullif(btrim(date_window), '') IS NOT NULL)

bookings_source_quote_complete.name: bookings_source_quote_complete
bookings_source_quote_complete.value: (source_quote_id IS NULL AND source_quote_option_id IS NULL AND source_quote_number IS NULL AND source_quote_version IS NULL AND source_booking_blueprint_version IS NULL) OR (source_quote_id IS NOT NULL AND source_quote_option_id IS NOT NULL AND source_quote_number IS NOT NULL AND source_quote_version IS NOT NULL AND source_booking_blueprint_version IS NOT NULL)

bookings_source_versions_positive.name: bookings_source_versions_positive
bookings_source_versions_positive.value: (source_quote_version IS NULL OR source_quote_version > 0) AND (source_booking_blueprint_version IS NULL OR source_booking_blueprint_version > 0)

clients_org_phone_idx.name: clients_org_phone_idx
clients_org_phone_idx.where: phone_number IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

clients_org_email_idx.name: clients_org_email_idx
clients_org_email_idx.where: email IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

crews_org_user_active_unique.name: crews_org_user_active_unique
crews_org_user_active_unique.where: user_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

crews_org_phone_idx.name: crews_org_phone_idx
crews_org_phone_idx.where: phone_number IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

expense_assignments_single_target.name: expense_assignments_single_target
expense_assignments_single_target.value: (booking_id IS NOT NULL AND shoot_id IS NULL AND crew_id IS NULL) OR (booking_id IS NULL AND shoot_id IS NOT NULL AND crew_id IS NULL) OR (booking_id IS NULL AND shoot_id IS NULL AND crew_id IS NOT NULL)

invoice_line_items_itemized_check.name: invoice_line_items_itemized_check
invoice_line_items_itemized_check.value: CASE WHEN type IN ('item', 'service') THEN quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0 AND unit_price IS NOT NULL AND unit_price >= 0 AND amount = quantity * unit_price ELSE TRUE END

invoice_line_items_lump_sum_check.name: invoice_line_items_lump_sum_check
invoice_line_items_lump_sum_check.value: CASE WHEN type IN ('milestone', 'expense') THEN quantity IS NULL AND unit_price IS NULL AND amount >= 0 ELSE TRUE END

invoices_active_payment_schedule_idx.name: invoices_active_payment_schedule_idx
invoices_active_payment_schedule_idx.where: payment_schedule_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

invoices_amounts_non_negative.name: invoices_amounts_non_negative
invoices_amounts_non_negative.value: subtotal >= 0 AND tax_amount >= 0 AND discount_amount >= 0 AND total_amount >= 0

payment_idempotency_completion_check.name: payment_idempotency_completion_check
payment_idempotency_completion_check.value: (status = 'processing' AND result_resource_id IS NULL AND result_payload IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status = 'completed' AND result_resource_id IS NOT NULL AND result_payload IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

payment_schedules_percentage_range.name: payment_schedules_percentage_range
payment_schedules_percentage_range.value: percentage IS NULL OR (percentage >= 0 AND percentage <= 100)

quote_line_items_shape.name: quote_line_items_shape
quote_line_items_shape.value: (type IN ('item', 'service') AND quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0 AND unit_price IS NOT NULL AND unit_price >= 0 AND amount = round(quantity * unit_price, 2)) OR (type IN ('milestone', 'expense') AND quantity IS NULL AND unit_price IS NULL)

quote_options_amounts_non_negative.name: quote_options_amounts_non_negative
quote_options_amounts_non_negative.value: subtotal >= 0 AND discount_amount >= 0 AND tax_amount >= 0 AND total_amount >= 0

quote_options_total_formula.name: quote_options_total_formula
quote_options_total_formula.value: discount_amount <= subtotal AND total_amount = subtotal - discount_amount + tax_amount

quote_options_blueprint_version_matches_.name: quote_options_blueprint_version_matches_payload
quote_options_blueprint_version_matches_.value: CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(booking_blueprint) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(booking_blueprint -> 'booking') = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(booking_blueprint -> 'schemaVersion') = 'number' AND (booking_blueprint ->> 'schemaVersion') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN booking_blueprint_version = (booking_blueprint ->> 'schemaVersion')::integer ELSE false END

quotes_no_self_lineage.name: quotes_no_self_lineage
quotes_no_self_lineage.value: supersedes_quote_id IS NULL OR supersedes_quote_id <> id

quotes_document_fields_complete.name: quotes_document_fields_complete
quotes_document_fields_complete.value: document_version IS NULL OR (document_version = 1 AND document IS NOT NULL AND document_sha256 IS NOT NULL)

quotes_pdf_fields_complete.name: quotes_pdf_fields_complete
quotes_pdf_fields_complete.value: (pdf_storage_key IS NULL AND pdf_sha256 IS NULL AND pdf_rendered_at IS NULL AND pdf_renderer_version IS NULL AND pdf_page_count IS NULL AND pdf_byte_size IS NULL) OR (pdf_storage_key IS NOT NULL AND pdf_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND pdf_rendered_at IS NOT NULL AND pdf_renderer_version IS NOT NULL AND pdf_page_count > 0 AND pdf_byte_size > 0)

receipts_active_received_amount_idx.name: receipts_active_received_amount_idx
receipts_active_received_amount_idx.where: received_amount_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

submission_feedback_rating_range.name: submission_feedback_rating_range
submission_feedback_rating_range.value: rating IS NULL OR (rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5)
